messages:
jordan: flagging odd customer case -- single client stream produced two confirmed charges after a toolcall and a cross-route fast-fail. attaching trace.

kai: can you paste ids + route info?

jordan: req=rz_44a1, sess=Se-77, initial route=west-1-a (8k), fallback route=west-1-b (64k)

maria: hm the model variants have different tokenizer configs; could cause prefix capture size mismatch. logs: 
```
2026-03-20T09:12:01Z INFO  capture.prefix len=112 tokens route=west-1-a
2026-03-20T09:12:02Z INFO  toolcall.invoke mailer offset=+9
2026-03-20T09:12:03Z ERROR client-eof truncated_stream
2026-03-20T09:12:03Z INFO  reconnect id=rz_44a1-1 route=west-1-b forwarded_headers=[X-Route-Tag]
2026-03-20T09:12:04Z INFO  provisional ledger=pr-321 amount=+9 state=provisional
2026-03-20T09:12:05Z INFO  confirm ledger=cf-654 amount=+9 state=confirmed
```

kai: looks like fallback route confirmed without matching the earlier provisional because the prefix length (token count) changed after tokenization on the 64k path; our ledger dedupe key currently uses (session,idempotency) + prefix_hash computed per-route. different tokenizer -> different hash -> double confirm.

jordan: the client did send Idempotency-Key but the router canonicalizes the prefix before forwarding and that step is not identical between the two model runtimes.

maria: short-term mitigation idea: compute prefix hash using a normalized unicode + byte-level hashing (not tokenizer-dependent) at the router before any route-specific tokenization. then use that hash in ledger dedupe. low-risk backend change.

kai: agree. will add metric `billing.stream.prefix_mismatch` and a histogram of token_len_diffs. we can measure how often route tokenizer differences cause mismatches.

ops-bot: created ticket OP-914: "router: normalize prefix hash for cross-model dedupe" assigned to @kai.

jordan: Console ask: ops needs to see "route path" and "prefix_hash" in the billing trace so they can correlate double-confirm cases quickly. currently Console collapses traces by session only.

console-bot: FE story FE-3812 created: "show route path and prefix-hash in Billing trace view" assigned to @maria. acceptance: show both fields, allow filter by prefix_hash, add a warning badge when duplicate confirms detected.

maria: FE note 0% of slips will need UX copy explaining why the same session can have multiple route confirmations. will propose tooltip: \"Different route tokenizers can change how prefixes are hashed; normalized hash is planned.\"

billing-bot: temporary billing mitigation: mark any confirmed charge where a provisional exists with identical session and normalized_hash within 2m as "suspect" and hold auto-invoice. tagging billing-team.

kai: plan: (1) implement normalized router-side hash + emit `billing.stream.prefix_mismatch` metric, (2) add dedupe rule using normalized_hash for recon attempts, (3) FE FE-3812 to surface route info and suspect badge, (4) billing hold rule for suspect confirms.

jordan: ETA for router patch?

kai: PR by EOD, rollout behind ff next Tuesday. metric starts in prod behind the flag.

maria: I'll prototype Console column and tooltip this sprint, need 4 days.

jordan: thanks all. for now I've flagged existing impacted customer invoices as "hold" and sent a note. will update incident when PR lands.

all: :thumbsup:
